subject: Commitment confirmation and start-date cadence
messages:
From: Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@satorihealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@atlascorp.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 18:08:00 +0000
Subject: Commitment confirmation and start-date cadence

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for walking through the MAP during yesterday's call. Attached is the latest MAP (MAP-v5.xlsx) and a one-page execution summary. We are targeting a firm service start date of Dec 16, 2026 so the SSO/SCIM onboarding and initial runbook testing need to be scheduled in the week prior.

Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood confirm the final signer window for institutional approval (we usually need VP Ops + CFO signatures)?
- Can you confirm whether DocuSign will be used and, if so, who will be the first signer on your side so we can align our legal ops team?

If possible, we'd like a go/no-go decision by Dec 6 so Atlas Procurement can finalize payment terms.

Attached: MAP-v5.xlsx, execution-summary-1p.pdf

Best,
Emma Jenkins
Head of Partnerships
Satori Health
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@satorihealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Commitment confirmation and start-date cadence

Emma — thanks for the MAP and the clear timing. Short update from Redwood:

- Legal has reviewed MAP-v5 and we have a redline summary in progress (Dev is looping legal redlines below).
- We can run DocuSign for signatures; I propose the following internal sign-off order: VP of Ops (Sean) -> Director Finance (Lauren). If that's acceptable to Satori, we can set the envelope to route that way.
- Internal signer window we can commit to: Dec 3–6 (we'll need to lock exact times once DocuSign envelope is created).

I've attached an internal execution-checklist.xlsx to make sure we don't miss onboarding tasks (SSO, routing, billing switch-over). Can everyone please confirm availability for a 30-minute sign-off readiness call on Dec 2? I can host at 10:00 PT / 18:00 UTC.

Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: execution-checklist.xlsx
From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 10:00:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Commitment confirmation and start-date cadence

Quick legal ops note — redlines are complete and summarized. The redline_summary.pdf lists three commercial points (billing cadence, data retention window, and limited SLA exception for pilot ramp). Legal is comfortable with the SOW as-is pending the payment cadence confirmation from Atlas.

I will create the DocuSign envelope and set routing VP Ops -> Director Finance. Expect the envelope to be ready by EOD Nov 29 (we'll seed in the SOW v3 and the MAP as attachments).

- Dev

Attachments: redline_summary.pdf
From: Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@satorihealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@atlascorp.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 14:35:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Commitment confirmation and start-date cadence

Thanks — that timing works on our end. Procurement confirms they can accept a Dec 3–5 signer window. We will prioritize VP Ops (internal) signature first so your routing order works.

Couple of clarifications:
- Can you confirm the billing cadence (monthly vs. quarterly)? Procurement says a net-30 invoice post-signature is preferred.
- For the start date, we're confirming Dec 16 as target. We need an SSO + runbook dry run by Dec 14 to ensure the integration smoke tests complete.

Attaching Satori-SOW-v3.pdf with a minor comment in section 2.2; otherwise ready to proceed.

Emma

Attachments: Satori-SOW-v3.pdf
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@satorihealth.com>, procurement@atlascorp.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 16:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Commitment confirmation and start-date cadence

Emma / Atlas team — final confirmation from Redwood: we are green to proceed with the proposed flow.

Plan:
- DocuSign envelope created (link: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123) and routed: Sean Gallagher (VP Ops) -> Lauren Bishop (Director Finance). Envelope will include Satori-SOW-v3.pdf and MAP-v5.xlsx and the execution-checklist.
- Signer window: Dec 3–5 (we'll send calendar invites for 10:00 AM PT slots; please confirm preferred minutes if you need a specific time).
- Billing cadence: monthly invoicing, net-30 terms. We'll include the first pro-rated invoice for partial December days in the initial billing run.
- Target start date: Dec 16, 2026. Onboarding dry run: Dec 14 (SSO + runbook smoke test). Please provide the SSO test account and the API allowlist by Dec 10.

Action items:
- Emma / Satori: confirm SSO test credentials and preferred time for signer slots (Dec 3–5).
- Atlas Procurement: confirm net-30 acceptance in an email reply (procurement@atlascorp.com).
- Dev/Legal (Redwood): will deploy DocuSign envelope by EOD Nov 29 and post the hubspot deal id.

If we get the signed envelope by Dec 6 we will move forward with provisioning and the onboarding calendar will be locked.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference
